title: Playlist and Recipe
author: Wendell Amberdale
blurb: Cyrus Underhill, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
